Quantinuum Q2 Earnings Call Highlights

Quantinuum (NASDAQ:QNT) reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of $8 million, up 279% from the prior-year period, in its first earnings call as a public company following its June initial public offering. Chief Executive Officer Raj Hazra said the company is pursuing leadership across quantum hardware
